project_inclusion.note: Native to Texas according to Kew; retained here primarily for field relevance.

morphology_keys.leaves: Cordate-ovate to deltate-ovate, entire or 3(–5)-lobed; glabrous or sparsely hairy.
morphology_keys.sepals: Elliptic-oblong to lanceolate, usually 11–14 mm, ciliate, acuminate.
morphology_keys.corolla: Usually white, sometimes pink-tinged; about 15–20(–25) mm.
morphology_keys.key: Small white flower + 11–14 mm pointed sepals; compare with I. triloba and I. cordatotriloba.
